<?php
class DynamicNameBox {
    public $slot = 11;
}
function choose_dynamic_name() {
    global $base, $replacement;
    $base = $replacement;
    return 'slot';
}
function read_dynamic_name() {
    global $base;
    return $base->{choose_dynamic_name()};
}
$base = new DynamicNameBox;
$old = $base;
$replacement = new DynamicNameBox;
$replacement->slot = 22;
echo 'VALUE|', read_dynamic_name(), '|OLD|', $old->slot,
    '|CURRENT|', $base->slot, '|';
